source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT
    PREVIOUS_MONTH_LAST_BUS_DAY AS [VALUE]
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE MONTH_END = 'Y'
    AND PREVIOUS_MONTH_LAST_BUS_DAY BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-05-01'
ORDER BY PREVIOUS_MONTH_LAST_BUS_DAY

parameters.EDS_SQL: BEGIN TRY CREATE TABLE #SRC_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT WITH ( DISTRIBUTION = HASH(CIF) ) AS SELECT ECD.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID, ECD.ORGKEY  AS CIF, CTR.CUST_SEGMENT_ID AS L1_SEGMENT_ID, CSP.PARAM_DESC AS L1_SEGMENT_DESC, DPMS.L2_SEGMENT_ID AS L2_SEGMENT_ID, DPMS.L2_SEGMENT_DESC AS L2_SEGMENT_DESC, CTR_PM.L1_SEGMENT_ID AS PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID, CTR_PM.L2_SEGMENT_ID AS PREV_L2_SEGMENT_ID FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL CTR ON ECD.ORGKEY = CTR.CIF AND ECD.BANK_ID = CTR.BANK_ID AND CTR.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM CSP ON CTR.CUST_SEGMENT_ID = CSP.PARAM_ID AND CTR.BANK_ID = CSP.BANK_ID AND CTR.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CSP.SCD_START_DATE AND CSP.SCD_END_DATE LEFT JOIN EDS.DSD_PROD_MODEL_SCORES DPMS ON DPMS.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND DPMS.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM DD ON DD.FULLDATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT CTR_PM ON CTR_PM.SCD_START_DATE = DD.PREVIOUS_MONTH_LAST_BUS_DAY AND ECD.ORGKEY = CTR_PM.CIF AND ECD.BANK_ID = CTR_PM.BANK_ID WHERE CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE UPDATE EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT SET [ISLATEST] = 0 ,[SCD_END_DATE] = ( SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT tgt INNER JOIN #SRC_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT src ON src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[CIF] = tgt.[CIF] WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], src.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])) <> HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])); INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT ( BANK_ID, CIF, L1_SEGMENT_ID, L1_SEGMENT_DESC, L1_PROMOTION_DATE, L1_DEMOTION_DATE, L1_PROMOTION_BY, L1_DEMOTION_BY, L2_SEGMENT_ID, L2_SEGMENT_DESC, L2_PROMOTION_DATE, L2_DEMOTION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_BY, ISLATEST, ISACTIVE, SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT BANK_ID, CIF, L1_SEGMENT_ID, L1_SEGMENT_DESC, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) < CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L1_PROMOTION_DATE, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) > CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L1_DEMOTION_DATE, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) < CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN 'EDS_ETLUSER' ELSE NULL END) AS L1_PROMOTION_BY, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) > CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN 'EDS_ETLUSER' ELSE NULL END) AS L1_DEMOTION_BY, L2_SEGMENT_ID, L2_SEGMENT_DESC, (CASE WHEN CAST(L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) < CAST(PREV_L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L2_PROMOTION_DATE, (CASE WHEN CAST(L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) > CAST(PREV_L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L2_DEMOTION_DATE, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS Date) AS LAST_UPDATED_DATE, 'EDS_ETLUSER' AS LAST_UPDATE_BY, 1 AS [ISLATEST], 1 AS [ISACTIVE], CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE, CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE] FROM #SRC_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT src WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT tgt WHERE src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[CIF] = tgt.[CIF] AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], src.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])) = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])) AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 ); END TRY BEGIN CATCH DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE(); THROW 51000 ,@msg ,1; END CATCH

IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 CNT FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL' AND PROCESS_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) BEGIN DELETE FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE); END; WITH CUST_TOT_REL_DEP AS ( SELECT EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE ,EDA.BANK_ID BANK_ID ,ECD.ORGKEY CIF ,SUM(COALESCE(YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS ,NULL TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP ,NULL TRB_BANCA ,NULL TRB_SECURITIES ,NULL TRE_LOANS ,NULL TRE_CARDS FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE WHERE EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ( 'M' ,'J' ) AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND LEFT(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE, 2) <> '09' AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N' AND EDA.DEL_FLG = 'N' AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AND EDA.NMA_KEY_TYPE NOT IN ( 'JCADD' ,'PCADD' ) GROUP BY EDA.AS_OF_DATE ,EDA.BANK_ID ,ECD.ORGKEY ) ,CUST_TOT_REL_TRY AS ( SELECT TAH.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE ,TAH.BNK_CODE BANK_ID ,TAH.CIF_ID CIF ,SUM(COALESCE(TAH.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP, 0)) TRB_TREASURY FROM EDS.TREASURY_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TAH WHERE TAH.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AND TAH.FOR_EXCLUSION = 'N' AND TAH.IS_QUALIFIED = 'Y' AND TAH.PRODUCT_GROUP NOT IN ( 'FX Product' ,'Derivative Product' ) GROUP BY TAH.AS_OF_DATE ,TAH.BNK_CODE ,TAH.CIF_ID ) ,CUST_TOT_REL_TRU AS ( SELECT TAH.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE ,TAH.BNK_CODE BANK_ID ,TAH.CIF_ID CIF ,SUM(COALESCE(TAH.MARKET_VALUE_PHP, 0)) TRB_TRUST FROM EDS.TRUST_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TAH WHERE TAH.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AND ( TAH.PRODUCT_GROUP = 'UITF' OR TAH.PRODUCT_CODE = 'AIMA' ) AND TAH.IS_QUALIFIED = 'Y' GROUP BY TAH.AS_OF_DATE ,TAH.BNK_CODE ,TAH.CIF_ID ) ,AGG_TRB AS ( SELECT DEP.AS_OF_DATE ,DEP.BANK_ID ,DEP.CIF ,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP ,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_BANCA, 0)) TRB ,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS ,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0)) TRB_INVEST ,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0)) TRB_TRUST ,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0)) TRB_TREASURY ,TRB_BANCA ,TRB_SECURITIES ,SUM(COALESCE(TRE_LOANS, 0) + COALESCE(TRE_CARDS, 0)) TRE ,TRE_LOANS ,TRE_CARDS FROM CUST_TOT_REL_DEP DEP LEFT JOIN CUST_TOT_REL_TRY TRY ON DEP.CIF = TRY.CIF AND DEP.BANK_ID = TRY.BANK_ID AND DEP.AS_OF_DATE = TRY.AS_OF_DATE LEFT JOIN CUST_TOT_REL_TRU TRU ON DEP.CIF = TRU.CIF AND DEP.BANK_ID = TRU.BANK_ID AND DEP.AS_OF_DATE = TRU.AS_OF_DATE GROUP BY DEP.AS_OF_DATE ,DEP.BANK_ID ,DEP.CIF ,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP ,TRB_BANCA ,TRB_SECURITIES ,TRE_LOANS ,TRE_CARDS ) INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL ( AS_OF_DATE ,BANK_ID ,CIF ,CUST_SEGMENT_ID ,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP ,TRB ,TRB_DEPOSITS ,TRB_INVEST ,TRB_TRUST ,TRB_TREASURY ,TRB_BANCA ,TRB_SECURITIES ,TRE ,TRE_LOANS ,TRE_CARDS ) SELECT AGG_TRB.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE ,AGG_TRB.BANK_ID ,AGG_TRB.CIF ,COALESCE(CSP.PARAM_ID, '006') AS CUST_SEGMENT_ID ,AGG_TRB.TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP ,AGG_TRB.TRB ,AGG_TRB.TRB_DEPOSITS ,AGG_TRB.TRB_INVEST ,AGG_TRB.TRB_TRUST ,AGG_TRB.TRB_TREASURY ,AGG_TRB.TRB_BANCA ,AGG_TRB.TRB_SECURITIES ,AGG_TRB.TRE ,AGG_TRB.TRE_LOANS ,AGG_TRB.TRE_CARDS FROM AGG_TRB LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM CSP ON CSP.BANK_ID = AGG_TRB.BANK_ID AND COALESCE(TRB, 0) BETWEEN CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(CSP.FROM_VALUE, '0'), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38, 6)) AND CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(CSP.TO_VALUE, '999,999,999,999,999'), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38, 6)) AND AGG_TRB.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CSP.SCD_START_DATE AND CSP.SCD_END_DATE
